I've been mapping out the core concepts and iconic terms of "Web Reactiva." I'm defining things like "Malandriner," "Podcast," "Newsletter," "Comunidad / Zona Premium," and exploring how these components fit together within Daniel Primo's ecosystem. I'm also delving into related themes such as side projects, the impostor syndrome, various coding aspects, automation, AI, and personal branding, all in the context of this specific community.

I'm now deep-diving into the game design. I envision "Web Reactiva Craft" as an "Infinite Craft"-style game. The plan is a single HTML file using core mechanics inspired by the original, but tailored to the "Web Reactiva" ecosystem. I've chosen starting elements, like "Código" and "Micrófono," and want to verify every single element is reachable.

I'm now focused on the user interface and how elements will interact. I'm visualizing an infinite canvas workspace where elements are dragged, dropped, and combined with satisfying visual and auditory feedback. I want intuitive drag-and-drop actions, clean highlighting, particle effects, and Web Audio sound. I'm planning for double-click duplication, sidebar removal, panning, zooming, and touch/mobile support using Pointer Events. The goal is a seamless and responsive experience.

I'm currently honing the UI for "Web Reactiva Craft," concentrating on the search bar and filter implementation. My plan involves instant filtering by name or emoji, alongside clear button functionality and diverse sorting options. I'm also adding filter pill tabs for various discoveries. A counter and progress bar for elements discovered are also in progress. Unique discovery milestones will trigger lore toasts and unlockable codex entries with descriptions.

I'm now implementing a "Pista Inteligente (Hint)" feature to prevent players from getting stuck. The hint system will analyze unlocked elements and suggest two already-owned elements that combine into an undiscovered one. I'm now focusing on optimizing early gameplay to prevent frustration from the procedural element combinations. I want to make the early game density near 100% by ensuring that almost every pair within the starting elements produces a curated, meaningful recipe. I'm now fully immersed in validating all details to ensure the game content is 100% authentic to the "Web Reactiva" lore. I'm aiming for insider accuracy and genuine humor, especially appealing to fans of Daniel Primo. I'm now fully immersed in ensuring every piece of content aligns perfectly with "Web Reactiva" lore. I aim for authentic details and inside jokes that resonate with Daniel Primo's community. I want to make procedurally generated "Inventos" hilarious.

I'm now organizing the foundational "Web Reactiva" themes into distinct categories. I'm focusing on "Cementerio de Dominios," representing the allure and subsequent frustrations of domain acquisition, alongside the "Side Project" loop. I'm looking at "Síndrome del Impostor," which explores the common imposter syndrome, and "Vendehumos" representing brogrammers. I am also planning on including "Deploy en Viernes", "Código Legacy," "No-Code & Automatización" and "IA & Vibe Coding".


**Architecting Starting Elements**

I'm now architecting the initial elements and recipes to ensure a captivating start to the game. I've chosen four core elements: Código, Micrófono, Café, and Curiosidad. I'm excited about how every pairing of these starting elements can immediately produce ten unique Tier-1 elements, maximizing initial engagement! My goal is to guarantee that the first ten combinations produce unique, Tier-1 elements.



**Refining Tier-1 Recipes**

I'm refining the Tier-1 recipes, focusing on intuitive combinations using the starting elements. My current plan involves adjusting initial recipes for better narrative flow, such as creating "Charla Tech" from "Código" and "Micrófono." I also considered "Podcast" as a build-up, and now I've reconsidered that choice. I'm prioritizing elements like "Oyente" and "Side Project." I'm aiming for a natural progression that mirrors the "Web Reactiva" ecosystem.

I'm diving into crafting a web-based Reactiva game, taking inspiration from Neal.fun's Infinite Craft. My focus is on making the game visually stunning and responsive, aiming for an unforgettable user experience. I'm prioritizing building a polished, feature-packed experience. I am designing the visual style of the game.


**Refining the Interface**

I'm currently refining the user interface, aiming for a balance between visual appeal and intuitive gameplay. I am envisioning a clean, crisp workspace with a dot-grid canvas reminiscent of Infinite Craft, alongside a practical sidebar for item management. I'm focusing on a mobile-first design, but also ensuring a polished desktop experience. I'm building with light and dark mode in mind.


**Envisioning Infinite Mode**

I'm now deeply engrossed in designing the "∞ Modo Infinito" feature. It needs to be a core element. Should it be on by default, like Infinite Craft? The prompt mentions the need to mirror the Infinite Craft experience where every combination works, and I'm aiming for the same seamlessness. I'm exploring how to make every combination result in something funny.


**Implementing Filtering Logic**

I'm now implementing the filtering logic for the sidebar. I'm considering options like "Todos," "Oficiales," and "Inventos," or toggling "Solo recetas oficiales." The "∞ Alquimia Infinita" feature will be on by default with a quick toggle for strict puzzle mode. My goal is to ensure that all combinations yield a chip, just like Infinite Craft.


**Designing Discovery Mechanics**

I'm now focusing on designing the discovery mechanics, integrating Spanish grammar, humorous elements, and emojis to craft engaging combinations. I envision the iconic "✨ ¡Primer Descubrimiento!" banner below each newly discovered chip, mirroring Infinite Craft's dopamine loop. I'm also implementing filter pills in the sidebar for `Todos`, `⚡ Oficiales`, `✨ Inventos`, and `⭐ Hitos` to ensure a curated experience and prevent procedural inventions from overshadowing canonical elements.


**Implementing Chip Interactions**

I'm now building out chip interactions. I'm focusing on smooth pointer tracking with rotation on drag, and a magnetic pulse and glow when chips are combinable. On drop, I'll implement Web Audio API sounds, a particle burst, and spring physics on the resulting chip. New elements will trigger a celebratory toast card with lore. I'm also adding double-click cloning and right-click to return to the sidebar.


**Adding Canvas Interactions**

I'm now adding interactions to the canvas. I'm focusing on adding panning with drag and zoom with the scroll wheel. I'll include 'Center' and 'Clear' buttons too! I'll also add auto-save functionality to local storage, saving elements, canvas state, themes, and sound preferences. There will be options to reset or export/import progress.



**Expanding Community Offerings**

I'm now integrating community elements, inspired by Daniel Primo's approach. I'm exploring features like a weekly audio podcast for relaxed listening, a Tuesday newsletter with curated content, and a Telegram group for instant support. I'm also considering a premium area with exclusive content and direct interaction, as well as virtual coffee sessions and mastermind groups. My goal is to create a vibrant community around the project, building on Primo's model of shared knowledge and support.


**Integrating Community Concepts**

I'm now integrating community concepts further. I'm exploring "Audio-curso," a 'learn while you walk' podcast, and the "Malandriner Challenge" for quick builds. Also, I'm thinking about live streams, a personal "Digital Garden" for slow-cooked ideas, and "Learning in Public" to share my journey.


**Cataloging Ideas & Tools**

I'm now cataloging new concepts and tools relevant to my project. I've been considering topics like "agueti," "Deuda Técnica," and "Viernes" which feels relevant to the project deployment. I've also been thinking about concepts like "burnout," "vendehumos," and "Síndrome del Impostor," which often feature in the life of builders. I'm noting the potential pitfalls of "Over-engineering" and the temptations of "Shiny Object Syndrome." I am also thinking about all the tools related to side projects, such as MVP, SaaS, etc.


**Testing Recipe Graph**

I'm now focusing on testing the recipe graph with a small Node script to ensure all 112 elements are reachable from the starting four. My goal is to use a breadth-first search to verify smooth progression across the tiers. I'll focus on ensuring every single element is accessible.


**Validating HTML Structure**

I'm now drafting the complete element and recipe dataset and plan to validate it before assembling `index.html`. My plan is to start by writing `index.html` and validate its embedded dataset directly using `node`. This approach ensures zero data drift. The checklist is detailed; I'll start with the header, focusing on a top-left brand pill and top-center/right canvas controls, including a progress pill and the "∞ Modo Infinito" toggle.


**Designing Action Bar**

I'm now designing the bottom-left canvas action bar, focusing on a "Pista" button for smart recipe hints using Breadth-First Search and an "Códice" button, which will provide a rich tabbed modal with official elements and achievements. The "Pista" button will suggest recipes with undiscovered elements and even spawn the necessary elements on the canvas. The modal will display all elements with visual cues and the achievements, providing an engaging game experience.


**Refining Discovery System**

I'm now refining the discovery system and sidebar filters. I'm focusing on the "⭐ Con combos" filter to show elements with undiscovered combinations. I'm implementing a recipe list, allowing players to click and spawn elements directly. I'm considering features like a visual "Humo" effect and the "Coleccionista Total" achievement. I am also working on adding controls to center and clear the canvas and reset the progress.



**Implementing Chip Interactions**

I'm now implementing the UI for chip creation and movement. Dragging a chip out of the sidebar creates a live, draggable element under my cursor immediately. Clicking will spawn the element in a strategic, non-overlapping spot close to the canvas center! I'm adding subtle hover effects and visual cues to enhance the experience.


**Developing Interaction Enhancements**

I'm now implementing new visual and interaction elements. I'm adding floating mini-formula labels (`💻 Código + ☕ Café = 👩‍💻 Programador`) to give feedback. The discovery banner will pop up when discovering new things. I'm working on a mobile-responsive layout for smaller screens, with the canvas on top and a bottom panel sidebar.

      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --text-soft: #64748b;
      --shadow-chip: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
      --shadow-chip-drag: 0 16px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 0 1px rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.45);
      --shadow-float: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      background: var(--bg-canvas);
      color: var(--text-main);
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
    }

    #app {
      display: flex;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* ================= CANVAS AREA ================= */
    #workspace {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
      background-image: radial-gradient(var(--dot-color) 1.35px, transparent 1.35px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
      cursor: grab;
      touch-action: none;
    }

    #workspace.panning {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    #fx-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 25;
    }

    #world {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 0;
      transform-origin: 0 0;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    /* Floating Header Brand */
    .brand-card {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      z-index: 30;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 11px;
      padding: 9px 14px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      max-width: calc(100% - 32px);
    }

    .brand-logo {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #facc15 0%, #f59e0b 55%, #ea580c 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .brand-text h1 {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .brand-badge {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.12);
      color: var(--wr-indigo);
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .brand-badge {
      background: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.18);
      color: #a5b4fc;
    }

    .brand-text p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-top: 2px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      max-width: 330px;
    }

    /* Top-right controls on workspace */
    .top-controls {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      z-index: 30;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .pill-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      color: var(--text-main);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-chip);
      transition: transform 0.14s ease, border-color 0.14s ease, background 0.14s ease;
    }

    .pill-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-chip-hover);
      background: var(--bg-chip-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .pill-btn:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .pill-btn.active-mode {
      border-color: var(--wr-indigo);
      background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.1);
      color: var(--wr-indigo);
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .pill-btn.active-mode {
      border-color: #818cf8;
      background: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.16);
      color: #c7d2fe;
    }

    .icon-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      padding: 0;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    /* Bottom toolbar on workspace */
    .bottom-toolbar {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      z-index: 30;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      pointer-events: none;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .toolbar-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      pointer-events: auto;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hint-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef3c7 0%, #fde68a 100%);
      border-color: #f59e0b;
      color: #78350f;
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .hint-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.24), rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.18));
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.55);
      color: #fde68a;
    }

    .zoom-indicator {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 6px 10px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 9px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    /* Empty workspace helper overlay */
    #empty-guide {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 5;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 24px;
      transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
    }

    #empty-guide.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .empty-guide-box {
      max-width: 390px;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1.5px dashed var(--border-chip);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
      backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .empty-guide-box {
      background: rgba(20, 25, 35, 0.55);
    }

    .empty-guide-box h2 {
      font-size: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .empty-guide-box p {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ================= ELEMENT CHIPS ================= */
    .chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      padding: 7px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      background: var(--bg-chip);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-chip);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-chip);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-main);
      cursor: grab;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: border-color 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease, background 0.14s ease, transform 0.14s ease;
      position: relative;
    }

    .chip:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-chip-hover);
      background: var(--bg-chip-hover);
    }

    .chip .emoji {
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .chip .label {
      line-height: 1.15;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .chip.milestone {
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.65);
    }

    .chip.procedural {
      border-style: dashed;
    }

    /* Canvas-placed chip */
    .canvas-chip {
      position: absolute;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      z-index: 12;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      touch-action: none;
    }

    .canvas-chip.dragging {
      cursor: grabbing;
      z-index: 100 !important;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-chip-drag);
      border-color: var(--wr-indigo);
      transition: none;
    }

    .canvas-chip.merge-target {
      border-color: var(--wr-amber) !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.32), var(--shadow-chip-drag) !important;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.09) !important;
    }

    .canvas-chip.pop-in {
      animation: chipPop 0.34s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }

    .canvas-chip.shake {
      animation: chipShake 0.32s ease;
    }

    .first-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -18px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      padding: 1.5px 7px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b, #ec4899, #6366f1);
      color: #fff;
      white-space: nowrap;
      pointer-events: none;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
    }

    .milestone-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--wr-amber);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .combo-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--wr-emerald);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    @keyframes chipPop {
      0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.35); opacity: 0.2; }
      70% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.12); opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
    }

    @keyframes chipShake {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(-6px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(6px); }
    }

    /* Floating drag clone from sidebar */
    #drag-ghost {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      z-index: 9999;
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-chip-drag);
      border-color: var(--wr-indigo);
      display: none;
    }

    /* Floating formula text on merge */
    .floating-formula {
      position: absolute;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 40;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-chip);
      white-space: nowrap;
      animation: floatUpFade 1.25s ease forwards;
    }

    @keyframes floatUpFade {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -10px) scale(0.9); }
      18% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -28px) scale(1); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -56px) scale(0.96); }
    }

    /* Discovery Toast Banner */
    #toast-container {
      position: absolute;
      top: 76px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 45;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      pointer-events: none;
      width: min(460px, calc(100% - 32px));
    }

    .discovery-toast {
      pointer-events: auto;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px 15px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--wr-amber);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      animation: toastSlide 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    .discovery-toast.info-toast {
      border-color: var(--wr-indigo);
    }

    .toast-emoji {
      font-size: 28px;
      line-height: 1;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .toast-body {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .toast-tag {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--wr-amber);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .discovery-toast.info-toast .toast-tag {
      color: var(--wr-indigo);
    }

    .toast-title {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .toast-desc {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .toast-action {
      margin-top: 7px;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: none;
      background: var(--wr-indigo);
      color: #fff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    @keyframes toastSlide {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px) scale(0.96); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }

    /* ================= SIDEBAR ================= */
    #sidebar {
      width: var(--sidebar-width);
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--bg-sidebar);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      z-index: 35;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    #sidebar.trash-hover::after {
      content: "🗑️ Soltar para quitar de la mesa";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 10px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.14);
      border: 2px dashed var(--wr-rose);
      color: var(--wr-rose);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 15px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
      z-index: 60;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .sidebar-header {
      padding: 14px 14px 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .progress-bar-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .progress-stats {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .progress-track {
      width: 100%;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .progress-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #facc15 0%, #f59e0b 45%, #4f46e5 100%);
      transition: width 0.35s ease;
    }

    .search-box {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .search-box input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 9px 32px 9px 34px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      color: var(--text-main);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
    }

    .search-box input:focus {
      border-color: var(--wr-indigo);
      background: var(--bg-surface);
    }

    .search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 11px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      pointer-events: none;
      color: var(--text-soft);
    }

    .search-clear {
      position: absolute;
      right: 8px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-soft);
      font-size: 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px;
      display: none;
    }

    .filter-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .filter-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tab-chip {
      padding: 5px 8.5px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.14s ease;
    }

    .tab-chip.active {
      background: var(--wr-indigo);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .sort-select {
      padding: 5px 7px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      color: var(--text-main);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      outline: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    #inventory-list {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 12px 14px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-content: flex-start;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    #inventory-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
    }

    #inventory-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--border-chip);
      border-radius: 99px;
    }

    .inv-empty {
      width: 100%;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 32px 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .sidebar-footer {
      padding: 9px 14px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--text-soft);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .footer-link-btn {
      border: none;
      background: none;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .footer-link-btn:hover {
      color: var(--wr-rose);
    }

    /* ================= MODAL (CÓDICE MALANDRINER) ================= */
    .modal-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(10, 14, 24, 0.58);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 200;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .modal-backdrop.open {
      display: flex;
    }

    .modal-card {
      width: min(820px, 100%);
      max-height: 86vh;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-float);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .modal-head {
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .modal-head h2 {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .modal-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .modal-tab {
      padding: 7px 13px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .modal-tab.active {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      color: var(--wr-indigo);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-chip);
    }

    .modal-body {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .cat-section {
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .cat-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .codex-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .codex-item {
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.14s ease, transform 0.14s ease;
    }

    .codex-item:hover:not(.locked) {
      border-color: var(--wr-indigo);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .codex-item.locked {
      opacity: 0.55;
      cursor: default;
    }

    .codex-item-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13.5px;
    }

    .codex-item-lore {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.38;
    }

    .codex-item-recipe {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--wr-indigo);
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .codex-item-recipe {
      color: #a5b4fc;
    }

    .ach-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .ach-card {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      display: flex;
      gap: 11px;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .ach-card.unlocked {
      border-color: var(--wr-amber);
      background: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.08);
    }

    .ach-icon {
      font-size: 26px;
      line-height: 1;
      filter: grayscale(1);
      opacity: 0.45;
    }

    .ach-card.unlocked .ach-icon {
      filter: none;
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .recipe-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      font-size: 13px;
      background: var(--bg-surface-2);
      gap: 8px;
